intro_eyebrow: Your finance department, from the outside
intro_title: Everything a finance team does, without hiring one.
intro_text:
Running a business means making decisions every day, and every one of them depends on numbers you can trust. Finlume takes care of the bookkeeping, payroll, tax and reporting behind the scenes, so you always know where you stand and never worry about a missed deadline.

We are a new, founder-led firm. That means personal attention, qualified oversight on every file and a partner who explains things in plain language.
services_title: Complete finance support, under one roof
services_lead: Choose a single service or let us run your entire finance function. Every engagement is tailored to the size and stage of your business.
deadlines_title: Your compliance calendar, kept by us

faq.question: What does outsourced accounting mean?
faq.answer: Instead of employing an in-house bookkeeper or accountant, you work with Finlume as your external finance department. We take care of your bookkeeping, payroll, tax and reporting, and you get qualified oversight without the cost of a full-time team.

faq.question: Do I need to be near you?
faq.answer: No. We serve clients across South Africa. Most work is done remotely using secure cloud accounting software, email and WhatsApp, and in-person meetings are available by appointment.

faq.question: Which accounting software do you work with?
faq.answer: We work with leading cloud platforms such as Xero, Sage and QuickBooks. If you don't use accounting software yet, we'll recommend and set up the option that suits your business.

faq.question: How are your fees set?
faq.answer: After a free consultation we send a tailored proposal with a clear scope of work. Ongoing services are billed as a fixed monthly fee and once-off projects are quoted upfront, so there are no surprises.

faq.question: Can you take over from my current accountant?
faq.answer: Yes. We manage the handover: we collect your records, review where things stand and make sure nothing falls through the cracks during the change.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Book a free consultation by phone, WhatsApp or the contact form. We'll discuss what you need, send a proposal and, once you're happy, start onboarding.
